notes.title: Update 2.2 fixing tingles and clicks
notes.content: A small bugfix that reenables the tingle sound effect after finishing a level. Also fixed the clicking sound not playing when the player clicks on the head of the snake to control it with the mouse.

notes.title: Update 2.1 featuring a tiny start indicator
notes.content: With the previous update the levels have become more darker. A new tiny start indicator will help in finding the starting spot at first glance when a level loads.

notes.title: Update 2, that makes the game a bit more flashy
notes.content:
Added an opaque moving parallax background. This will make the more bright levels a little bit more pleasant to look at. The feature is on by default but can be turned off in the lower right corner.
Please let me know how do you guys feel about it.

notes.title: Update 1 is here! What has been changed?
notes.content:
New feature: Guide Spots. These will break down the maze to smaller segments, so it will be much easier to solve them. Remember, the game should have been mildly challenging and not painfully difficult.

Bug fixes: 
- on the level selection level 51 now correctly labelled.
- maze walls are a little bit less bright.
